housekeeping.description: Sweep a file, a related set of files, or a small repo for dead code, tracked junk, docs drift, DX friction, and leftover scaffolding after partial removals. Use when the user asks if something needs housekeeping, cleanup, a tidy pass, or says "rm more" / "sweep the floor" after recent deletions.

naming-conventions.description: Clear rules for casing, intent, and structure to keep the codebase clean and consistent.
